limitations: Frozen core BASE-LIFE-18 listener callbacks after destroy are observed separately from candidate cleanup.
Finite lifecycle checks do not prove unbounded heap stability or physical-device support.
Direct main/legacy bytes are not isolated installed-package distribution acceptance.
Mask/PiP combined-load performance and remaining old-plugin combinations remain open.
